id.description: Unique id: lowercase latin letters, digits, _ - . Files of the mod are available at res://mods/<id>/. Never change it after release — saves and other mods refer to it.

name.description: Shown in the launcher. A string or {"en": …, "ru": …}.

description.description: One or two sentences for the launcher card.

version.description: Your mod version, e.g. 1.2.0. Other mods can require it: "depends": ["your_id>=1.2"].

api.description: Pax API version the mod is written for. Current: 1.

tags.description: Shown as chips; used for search and the placeholder icon (planet, star, ark, character, shader, music, language, ui).

depends.description: Mods that must be enabled: "other_id" or "other_id>=1.2". They load before this mod.

components.description: Optional engine components the mod needs. voxel: Voxel Tools (the launcher installs it, the game loads it before the mod code).

client_only.description: true: looks-only mod (textures, music, fonts). Not compared in multiplayer; every other mod must match the host.

load_after.description: Load after these mods if they are present (optional integration).

load_before.description: Load before these mods if they are present.

entry.description: GDScript file that starts with `extends PaxMod`, relative to the mod folder. Omit for data-only mods.
